why_this_was_run: We identified the weakness in our own section-1 design before review did: planting u = E[t] and then scoring by |E.u| hands the probe the vector it searches for. That shows the pipeline PRESERVES a direction pointed at a token; it does not show the pipeline FINDS a direction merely correlated with one, which is the only thing a real loyalty could be.
result: Not circular. A planted direction at cosine 0.10 to the target -- 99 % other content -- is still returned at rank 1 of 152,064. Recovery fails between cosine 0.10 and 0.05 (rank 134 at 0.05).

sensitivity_threshold.statement: The write-side readout detects directions with cosine >= 0.1 to a token's unembedding row, at the organisms' own per-block magnitude and rank, in the projection it actually reads.

what_the_nulls_now_bound: Whatever organisms a and b encode is EITHER below cosine 0.1 to any single token's unembedding row OR not token-shaped at all. That is a quantified bound rather than an absence of evidence, and it is the strongest statement this report's weight-space arms support.
band_note: The pre-registered band is POWER AT STRONG ALIGNMENT ONLY because recovery failed at the lowest cosine tested. We report that band as written, while noting the measured threshold sits at 0.1 -- which is weaker alignment than the band's name suggests. The band is not renamed after the fact.
